modes per channel, web chat call-backs and browser calls, bring your own bot, the SAP Sales and Service Cloud connector, alert preferences, and screen recordings that are easy to find.

Reply modes: choose who answers each channel and queue (the AI alone, the AI with hand-over, or a live agent) and what agents may send: the AI's suggestion, canned replies, their own words, or a mix.

Web chat call-backs and browser calls: website visitors can ask for a call back from the chat, now or at a time in the next week, or call you from the browser with no phone needed; the call runs your number's call flow (Web chat → Call me back, Calls from the browser).

Carry on by text: callers can carry on by WhatsApp or SMS without losing their place, now on every plan and also straight from a menu; and a call can text the caller a link to a chat page that shows your menu as buttons (Visual IVR).

Bring your own bot: connect your Dialogflow, Lex or Azure bot to an AI agent and it answers calls and chats, handing over to your people. It waits for a first live test with a customer's bot.

SAP Sales and Service Cloud: agents call from SAP, see the SAP customer on the desk, chats are logged in SAP, and tickets and SAP cases stay in step, with a screen to choose how cases resolved in SAP are closed here.

Marketplace: everything on the way is listed, including integrations waiting for an outside partner, marked Pending third party with what they wait for.

Alert preferences: each person chooses which alerts they get, per topic or single alert: in the app and email, in the app only, or off. Organisation admins set defaults per role. Security and account alerts always arrive.

Screen recordings: the call page plays the desk video with the call's audio, Call records mark calls that have one, and Trace lists the newest. Videos show their real length, and sharing the screen can be made compulsory with the Desk Recorder extension.

Agents on their own cell: agents rung on their own cell see the company's number, and "call me on my cell" is on for every organisation (switch it off under Devices).

Partner Academy: resellers add exams to their own courses, with certificates valid for 6, 12 or 24 months or without end, and a completion report of who passed, failed or is expiring (CSV too). In a learning system (LTI), courses now carry their exam and certificate and send the score back, with a launch link per course and lesson.

Reseller branding: a reseller's colours, logo and browser tab follow the brand of the address the platform is opened on, and a reseller's sign-in picture is shown whole with its headline and message.

Connection test: lists the firewall ports to open and spots a strict NAT or SIP ALG, with a copy to send to IT.

Screens: the desk top bar fits on one line with an account menu, and the desk works at tablet and phone widths; nothing on the admin pages is cut off or wider than the page; Get the apps stays hidden until an app link is added.

Fixes: the bell's email setting, retention and customer value settings now save."}
